lyrics:
[Intro: flute melody, bouncing bass, bird calls]

[Verse 1: female voice, light, French]
Sous le parasol, il fait bon
Le monde est loin, le temps est long
Un verre, un livre, un peu de vent
On ne fait rien, et c'est charmant

[Chorus: both voices, bouncing groove]
Sous le parasol
Rien à faire, rien à dire
Sous le parasol
Juste toi, et un sourire
Sous le parasol

[Verse 2: male voice, relaxed, French]
Le soleil tourne, on le suit
On pousse la chaise, sans un bruit
Demain peut-être, on verra
Aujourd'hui, on reste là

[Chorus: both voices, marimba answering]
Sous le parasol
Rien à faire, rien à dire
Sous le parasol
Juste toi, et un sourire
Sous le parasol

[Instrumental: flute solo over the groove]

[Outro: flute, a glass, "Encore un?" "Oui."]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 110 BPM, 4/4, D major. Light, bouncing and sunny, with a wink.

VOICE: A woman sings verse 1 and a man verse 2, both in French, softly and playfully, half-spoken. They sing the chorus together in unison and a simple harmony. Two spoken words each at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A breathy flute melody, a bouncing synth bass, a soft kick with hand percussion, marimba, a vintage organ, exotica bird calls, a little steel guitar.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, flute. 0:16 Verse 1, her. 0:44 Chorus 1. 1:06 Verse 2, him. 1:34 Chorus 2. 1:56 Flute solo. 2:24 Outro, flute, a glass and two spoken lines, ends 2:58.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Late-2010s French electronic pop with exotica colours: warm, clean and playful, flute and voices close.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The flute melody at 0:00, which returns as a solo.

STATION FIT: Sunday, 11 a.m. The lightest track in the set, for late breakfast. Translation of the chorus: under the umbrella, nothing to do, nothing to say, just you and a smile.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Lazy, content, playful, one more.
